items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Well there’s a friend of mine who was the provost at the University of Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: Wow. How did you come across this?

Well there’s a friend of mine who was the provost at the University of Pittsburgh. And he’s a very good friend of Dr. Nathan Davis, who is the head of the jazz studies, this was Dr. Donald Henderson. And he and his wife, I mean he’s retired now, oh he told me some stories about being a provost, I mean racism boy — like he was supposed to send a picture with his resume because he was accepted at five different colleges. He didn’t send a picture and he was accepted at every one. And when he came to Pittsburgh,…
